decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for certification.

For material limitations in named launch use cases, policy requires disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
General public risk-management or model-card guidance can support process quality but cannot replace missing policy-required disclosure or approval.
